base_features.token_selection: all valid final hidden states from current front/wrist images and instruction only

diagnostics.limits: Train overfit and controlled conditioning only; no validation/test generalization claim, no Step 2 gate assessment.
diagnostics.loss: L1 only for bounded implementation checks; L1+SSIM supported but production weights unfrozen
diagnostics.optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay=0, clip global gradient norm to 1
diagnostics.selection: 4 train tasks by ascending SHA256(pixel-step3-diagnostic-v1:task_key); lowest SHA256(pixel-step3-diagnostic-v1:episode_index) per task; common anchor floor((L-33)/2), all 5 horizons
diagnostics.synthetic: Identical current images/features/state; action multisets equal. Targets differ only by action order and horizon.

feature_prompt: Represent the current scene and instruction for predicting robot action consequences.

interface.actions: 32 padded ordered 7D actions; first h entries only; original action at t+h excluded
interface.decoder: shared four bilinear-upsample/conv/GroupNorm/GELU stages; tanh residual plus current image; clamp to [0,1]
interface.initial_prediction: exact current-frame copy via zero-initialized residual output layer

normalizers: Exact train-only trajectory-v2 action statistics and current-state q01/q99 from the fixed B0 recipe; no new fitting
production_budget_status: Pending Step 4: loss weights, sampling, effective batches, update budget, recovery/resume and resource pilot.
vla_integration: Expose future tokens; no OFT action-head change or action-policy training in Step 3.
